text:
The cardiac cycle consists of atrial systole, isovolumetric ventricular contraction, ventricular ejection, isovolumetric ventricular relaxation, and ventricular filling. Systole covers isovolumetric contraction and ejection; diastole covers isovolumetric relaxation, ventricular filling, and atrial systole. Each cycle moves blood from the atria through the ventricles into the arteries.
